svg.aria-label: A user writes a comment to the leader, then refreshes and the read goes to a follower that has not received the comment yet, so it looks lost. The fix routes that user’s reads to the leader for a short time.
svg.title: A user writes a comment to the leader, then refreshes and the read goes to a follower that has not received the comment yet, so it looks lost. The fix routes that user’s reads to the leader for a short time.
svg.text: Replication lag: “where did my comment go?”
